title: owner-question: Access channel and corex-full composition
question: Какой release-канал у native axiomasoft/corex-access после P07.4: public (входит в full-public) или private (исключён из full-public)? Подтвердить отдельно канал access-azguard.

options.text: Native access public; full-public includes its complete public closure; optional AzGuard bridge private.
Native access private and optional AzGuard bridge private; full-public excludes both.

context: Access source composer has only CoreX, Illuminate and clock runtime dependencies. Only legacy release-1.0-policy calls access private; D119 had no accepted policy basis. AzGuard dependency visibility is unverified.
consequences: Owner only. P09.6 stops before channel table/profile/SBOM classification is finalized. Public dependency set is computed from accepted channel map, then proven to have no private closure.
22 identities stay fixed; public/private counts are computed after answer, not hardcoded to 20/2.

sections.title: Owner clarification: repository visibility
sections.text: Owner replies in current P08 repair: «это будет полностью публиный репозиторий, название я поменяю»; later clarification «azguard открытый, corex пока будет закрытым». AzGuard public source verified without authentication; CoreX repository remains private for now. This establishes repository visibility, not a final release-channel map for native access/access-azguard or corex-full. D123 stays open until that publication policy is explicit; neither proposed A nor B is inferred from repository visibility. No visibility/manifest/channel changes or publication authorized.
